title: WCW roots: Dusty’s alliance vs. the Horsemen
summary: In Jim Crockett Promotions, Dusty Rhodes and his allies fight the Four Horsemen’s collective power. WarGames puts both sides inside a double cage and becomes a signature format inherited by WCW.

chapters.title: The first WarGames
chapters.show: JCP Great American Bash tour — Atlanta
chapters.result: Rhodes, Koloff, the Road Warriors and Ellering defeat the Horsemen and Dillon.
chapters.context: Targeting Dillon finally gives the Horsemen’s enemies a way to defeat the group together. This is JCP history preceding Turner-owned WCW.

chapters.title: The Horsemen lose the rematch
chapters.show: JCP Great American Bash tour — Miami
chapters.result: Rhodes’ team defeats the Horsemen and replacement partner War Machine.
chapters.context: Replacing the injured Dillon cannot reverse the result; the cage provides another payoff to the faction war.
